name: Marvel Champions: The Card Game

categories.label: Heroes won (villain defeated)
categories.hint: Win by reducing the villain's final stage to 0 HP

winCondition: Players win by reducing the villain's last (second) form to 0 health. They lose if all heroes are knocked out or the villain's scheme completes its final stage.

endCondition.description: Villain defeated, all heroes defeated, or villain scheme completed.

notes: family: coop. No points; win/lose only. Standard mode has two villain stages; expert mode and campaign rules add modifiers (not modelled). Verified only via secondary summary; official rulebook PDF could not be fetched (FFG CDN 403).
